column4: The kids from our mentorship program are already learning in the container-bib.
This is how the container looks like before our mentees arrive.
By nature a container is not the most beatiful piece of art that is why we started painting it.
As you can see there is still much space left for our kids to paint the container-bib.
Around the container the kids can have fun as well.
Of course our self-painted Smiles Africa logo cannot be missing on the container.
Our container-bib also is a place to interact with each other.
All the beauty of our container-bib.
The main purpose of the container-bib is to offer a place for learning and creative freedom to the 50 children and young people of our mentorship program.
